summary: Implemented a server-only GitHub App publication path with installation-scoped tokens, paginated repository selection, exact-byte deduplicated webhooks, fresh protected-branch/check/review validation, signed-human payload permits, idempotent reviewed-SHA PR merge, and retirement of every companion PAT/direct-push bypass.

files.purpose: GitHub App JWT, installation tokens, repository selection, policy validation, permits and protected merge

checks.summary: Nine focused GitHub App, pagination, policy, merge, reconciliation, permit and webhook tests passed.
Legacy /git/action returned 410 and push/send-pack bypass assertions passed.
Independent production build passed; 102 application tests passed with one opt-in skip and all 16 companion tests passed.
Independent serial Playwright regression passed 7/7 against the rebuilt runtime.
Blocked without a configured GitHub App ID/private key/webhook secret/publication signing secret and disposable protected repository; no remote mutation was attempted.

risks: Live provider behavior must be rerun after an operator creates and installs a GitHub App on a disposable repository with required checks and reviews.
No external merge was performed because publication remains separately human-controlled.
followUps: Configure a disposable GitHub App test installation and run the protected publication smoke before production release.
